releaseNotes: Added a built-in ad blocker (Settings -> Privacy) that blocks requests to known ad servers and ad exchanges, with a shield indicator in the address bar showing how many ads were blocked on the current page
Fixed recently-closed tabs always showing "CX Browser" instead of the actual page title for internal pages (New Tab, Settings, History, Bookmarks, Downloads, About)
Release changelogs are now written in English
Added Discord webhook support to announce new releases automatically
